Title: Azure Pipelines YAML CD features are now available with Azure DevOps update

Body.Content:
The latest Azure DevOps update includes several improvements to the Azure Pipelines user experience, including general availability of Azure Pipelines YAML CD features.

Additional Azure Pipelines enhancements include:

  • Service connections new UI as default experience
  • Role-based access for service connections
  • Showing associated CD pipeline info in CI pipeline
  • Cross-project sharing of service connections is now public
  • Pipeline resource version picker in the create run dialogue
